purpose: Replicate the PubMed-motivated acceptance change on different dataset/checkpoint cohorts without further tuning.
queries: All 100 validation queries from each input. These lists were used in prior development, not newly held-out confirmation. No outcomes filter the lists.
control: Rerun both acceptance policies with the same settings on the saved saliency initialization. Historical mixed-search runs used other proposal caps, so do not substitute their terminal supports for the new matched control.
metrics: Paired binary necessity/sufficiency wins, losses, ties and tradeoffs; continuous confidence drops; support identity; actual proposal counts and search time. Audit every accepted step against the appropriate invariants.
cost_scope: Sequential runs on the shared GPU. Equal proposal and step caps do not imply equal actual work. No cross-method timing claim from historical runs.
decision: Preserve all results and regressions. No grouping contribution is implied, no default promotion or LaTeX numerical changes before reviewing replication and cost.
